title: AC 01.1 – Subject Filter – No options displayed on open
description: AC 01 — Decision Table — Subject filter shows no confusing partial suggestions when opened without text entry.
preconditions:
User role: HQ/CM Staff
Location: Riso TAC (Teacher Availability Calendar)
Subject list exists in system (≥3 subjects configured)
No text entered in Subject filter field yet
steps_actions:
1. "Navigate to Riso TAC page"
2. "Locate Subject filter dropdown"
3. "Click on Subject filter dropdown to open"
4. "Verify no autocomplete options shown"
steps_result:
1. "TAC page loads successfully"
2. "Subject filter control visible"
3. "Dropdown opens; no partial suggestions displayed"
4. "Empty state or placeholder text shown (per Figma design)"

title: AC 01.2 – Subject Filter – Search matches subject by name
description: AC 01 — Equivalence Partitioning — Subject search returns matching subjects after user enters search term.
preconditions:
User role: HQ/CM Staff
Location: Riso TAC
Subject list configured: ["Mathematics", "English", "Science", "History"]
Subject filter dropdown opened
steps_actions:
1. "Type "Math" in Subject filter field"
2. "Verify filtered list contains "Mathematics""
3. "Click "Mathematics" to select"
4. "Observe calendar display"
steps_result:
1. "Dropdown updates with matching subjects"
2. "Mathematics appears in dropdown list"
3. "Subject filter applied; Mathematics shown as selected"
4. "Calendar shows lessons for Mathematics subject only"

title: AC 01.3 – Subject Filter – Search no matches
description: AC 01 — Equivalence Partitioning (Negative) — Subject search returns no results when search term has no matches.
preconditions:
User role: HQ/CM Staff
Location: Riso TAC
Subject list configured: ["Mathematics", "English", "Science", "History"]
Subject filter dropdown opened
steps_actions:
1. "Type "Xyz123" in Subject filter field (non-matching)"
2. "Verify no matching subjects displayed"
3. "Clear search field"
steps_result:
1. "Dropdown updates"
2. "Empty state message or No results found shown"
3. "Dropdown closes or returns to no-options state"

title: AC 01.4 – Subject Filter – Clear filter resets state
description: AC 01 — Decision Table — Subject filter clear action returns to initial no-options state.
preconditions:
User role: HQ/CM Staff
Location: Riso TAC
Subject filter has search term entered and results visible
Subject filter dropdown is open
steps_actions:
1. "Subject filter shows "Math" search results"
2. "Click clear button (X icon) or reset filter"
3. "Verify calendar shows all lessons (no subject filter applied)"
steps_result:
1. "Results visible in dropdown"
2. "Filter input cleared; dropdown closes or returns to no-options state"
3. "Subject filter removed; all lessons on TAC visible"
